'''Danta Greco''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he resided on the [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Danta Greco appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Smuggler Tier 4 gear vendor on the Republic Fleet in Game Update 5.2 on [[April 18]], [[2017]]. He became a Spoils of War pet vendor in Game Update 6.0 vendor on [[October 22]], [[2019]].
